description: This file is a React component named InputParametersTab that manages the UI for viewing, creating, editing, and deleting input parameters associated with an asset. It interacts with backend API endpoints to fetch and update data, renders a data table, and handles form modals for creating/editing input parameters. It also manages user permissions, loading/error states, and related data like UOMs and reporting programs.

methods.name: buildUomIndex
methods.description: Creates a map for quick UOM lookup by UOM ID from a list of UomMasterDto objects.

methods.name: buildProgIndex
methods.description: Creates a map for quick Reporting Program lookup by Program ID from a list of ReportingProgramMasterDto objects.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the list of input parameters for the current asset and updates state; maintains selection if possible.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal dialog for creating a new input parameter.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal dialog for editing an existing input parameter.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the save operation for creating or updating an input parameter, including validation, API calls, and state updates.
